connector.name: Video Render MCP
connector.registryDescription: Fireship-style short videos from a topic - Remotion motion graphics, word-timed captions, 1080p.
connector.summary: Hosted at video-render.regiq.in over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the globalion account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
